# llama.cpp framework

Built from ggml-org/llama.cpp tag b12143 (commit 2bc46baa9207d098d03741ac394e7faaf1a955b6) with `./build-xcframework.sh ios-sim ios-device`. The generated debug symbols were omitted from this source tree; the iOS device and simulator frameworks are included. See `llama.LICENSE`.

Liquid AI model weights are downloaded by the app only when the user taps the download button. They are stored in app-private Application Support and are not committed here.
